d: Ascending walls, rocks and hills as effortlessly as a monkey, Jyothi Raju hails from Karnataka and is a self-taught climber whose abilities could rival the crème de la crème in the climbing world. His prowess in climbing has astonished people, and what makes his acts even more daring is that he climbs fearlessly without the use of any safety gear. He persistently pushes his limits and aims for loftier summits and it is no surprise that he has affectionately earned the name, "The Monkey King."
